questions.stem: 社會企業（social enterprise）的獲利越多，能雇用的弱勢者就越多，幫助更多家庭擺脫貧窮的循環。
questions.answer: The more profit a social enterprise makes, the more disadvantaged people it can hire, helping more families break the cycle of poverty.
accepted_answers: The more money a social enterprise earns, the more people from disadvantaged groups it can employ, allowing more families to escape the cycle of poverty.
The more profitable a social enterprise is, the more underprivileged people it can hire, enabling more families to break free from the cycle of poverty.

patterns: 愈…愈…（獲利越多，能雇用的弱勢者就越多）
句尾分詞片語表結果（…，幫助更多家庭…）

questions.stem: 然而，要找出這些人真正需要的並不容易，因為造成貧窮的原因往往不只一個。
questions.answer: However, it is not easy to identify what these people really need, because poverty often has more than one cause.
accepted_answers: However, it is not easy to figure out what these people truly need, since poverty is usually caused by more than one factor.
However, it is difficult to find out what these people actually need, as there is often more than one cause of poverty.

patterns: what 名詞子句（這些人真正需要的＝what these people really need）
虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞（要找出…並不容易）

1.explanation_zh: 「…越多，…就越多」用 the more＋名詞＋S＋V, the more＋名詞＋S＋V；第二個子句的「能雇用的弱勢者」要把 the more disadvantaged people 整個放在前面，再接 it can hire。「幫助更多家庭擺脫貧窮的循環」是前面這件事帶來的結果，用句尾分詞 helping more families (to) break the cycle of poverty；「貧窮的循環」是固定說法 the cycle of poverty。
evidence: 社會企業（social enterprise）的獲利越多，能雇用的弱勢者就越多
幫助更多家庭擺脫貧窮的循環
1.strategy_zh: 先寫兩個 the＋比較級子句，注意比較級要帶著名詞一起移到開頭；最後在逗號後用 helping more families … 帶出結果。
hints: 切成四段：社會企業的獲利越多／能雇用的弱勢者就越多／幫助更多家庭／擺脫貧窮的循環
標的詞彙：profit（獲利）、hire（雇用）、disadvantaged（弱勢的）、family（家庭）、poverty（貧窮）
句型框架：The more + N + S + V, the more + N + S + can V, helping + O + VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「要找出…並不容易」用虛主詞 It is not easy to …；「這些人真正需要的」沒有中心名詞，用 what 名詞子句 what these people really need 當 identify／find out 的受詞，語序是直述句。「因為造成貧窮的原因往往不只一個」把抽象名詞 poverty 當主詞改寫成 poverty often has more than one cause，或用被動 poverty is often caused by more than one factor；more than one 後接單數名詞。
evidence: 要找出這些人真正需要的並不容易
造成貧窮的原因往往不只一個
2.strategy_zh: 句首 However, 接虛主詞句；受詞是一個 what 子句；最後用 because 帶出原因，並把「原因不只一個」改寫成 has more than one cause。
hints: 切成四段：要找出／這些人真正需要的／並不容易／因為造成貧窮的原因往往不只一個
標的詞彙：easy（容易）、identify（找出）、need（需要）、poverty（貧窮）、cause（原因）
句型框架：It is not easy to identify + what + S + V, because …

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「貧窮」在這裡是名詞 poverty；poor 是形容詞，不能放在 of 後面當名詞用。
「循環」指一再重複的惡性循環，用 cycle；circulation 是血液、貨幣的「流通」。

traps.literal_error: helping more families escape the poor circulation
traps.explanation_zh: 「貧窮的循環」是抽象名詞片語，英文固定說 the cycle of poverty（或 the poverty cycle）；poor 是形容詞，circulation 是「流通」，都不能用。

traps.literal_error: the more disadvantage it can hire
traps.explanation_zh: 「弱勢者」指處境不利的人，英文用 disadvantaged people（或 the disadvantaged）；disadvantage 是名詞「不利條件」，不能指人。「越…越…」也要把 the more disadvantaged people 整個放到子句開頭，再接 it can hire。

bonus.text: The more profit a social enterprise generates, the more jobs it can offer to disadvantaged people, lifting more families out of poverty for good.
bonus.explanation_zh: generate profit（創造獲利）、offer jobs to …（提供工作給…）與 lift … out of poverty（使…脫貧）都是道地搭配，for good 表示「永久地」。

traps.literal_error: because the reasons causing poor are often not only one
traps.explanation_zh: 「貧窮」要用抽象名詞 poverty，不是形容詞 poor；整句也不要逐字翻，改寫成以 poverty 為主詞的 poverty often has more than one cause，或 poverty is often caused by more than one factor。

traps.literal_error: However, find out what these people really need is not easy.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「要找出…」直接當主詞；英文動詞原形不能當主詞，改用虛主詞 It is not easy to find out …。

bonus.text: However, finding out what these people really need is no easy task, for poverty seldom has a single cause.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用動名詞主詞加 no easy task（絕非易事），後半用 for（因為）和 seldom has a single cause（很少只有單一原因）的否定說法，語氣更精鍊。

1.translation: The more profit a social enterprise makes, the more disadvantaged people it can hire, helping more families escape the cycle of poverty.
1.explanation_zh: 「越…就越…」用 The more ..., the more ... 比較級句型；「弱勢者」譯 disadvantaged people；「幫助更多家庭擺脫貧窮的循環」是結果，用句尾分詞 helping more families escape the cycle of poverty（也可用 break the cycle of poverty）。

2.translation: However, it is not easy to find out what these people really need, because there is often more than one cause of poverty.
2.explanation_zh: 「要找出…並不容易」用 it is not easy to find out；「這些人真正需要的」用 what 名詞子句；「因為…」用 because 副詞子句；「造成貧窮的原因往往不只一個」用 there is often more than one cause of poverty，比直譯 the causes ... are not only one 自然。

issues_zh: 第 1 部分（要找出）只收 to identify／to find out 等不定詞，第 3 部分（並不容易）只收 it is not easy 等虛主詞開頭。動名詞主詞 Finding out what these people really need is not easy 文法正確、很自然（加分寫法 finding out … is no easy task 正是這個結構），卻會同時丟第 1、3 部分共 2 分。建議兩部分都補動名詞主詞的寫法，或把 NFSUBJ 拆成的這兩部分合併評分。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：第 1 部分（要找出）只收 to identify／to find out 等不定詞，第 3 部分（並不容易）只收 it is not easy 等虛主詞開頭。動名詞主詞 Finding out what these people real

1.translation: The more profit a social enterprise makes, the more disadvantaged people it can hire, helping more families break free from the cycle of poverty.
1.explanation_zh: 「越……就越……」用 the more ..., the more ... 比較級對應結構；「幫助更多家庭擺脫」用分詞構句 helping ... break free from；「貧窮的循環」是 the cycle of poverty。

2.translation: However, it is not easy to find out what these people really need, because poverty is often caused by more than one factor.
2.explanation_zh: 「要找出……並不容易」用虛主詞 it；「這些人真正需要的」用名詞子句 what these people really need；「造成貧窮的原因往往不只一個」改成被動 poverty is often caused by more than one factor，避免直譯 cause 當主詞的累贅。
